messages:
maya: Opening a tiny PR to standardize streaming + pagination snippets across Py/TS/Go. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4920

sam: I'll review TS and run snippet lint.

alex: I'll do Python; will add both sync and async variants.

jia: I'll check Go examples; keep them minimal.

maya: Key asks: async iterator style for streams, short inline retry helper (no external deps), and a one-line caveat: tokens are opaque and may be invalidated.

sam: Draft TS snippet (async iterator + inline retry):

```ts
const s = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'TL;DR' })
for await (const chunk of s) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta ?? '') }

async function retry(fn, tries=3){ for(let i=0;i<tries;i++){ try{return await fn()}catch(e){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000*(2**i))) } } throw new Error('exhausted') }
```

alex: Python compact async + sync resume:

```python
# async
async for m in client.chat.stream(model='redwood-1', input='Shorten this'): print(m.text)

# sync (blocking)
for m in client.chat.stream_sync(model='redwood-1', input='Shorten this'): print(m.text)
```

jia: Go recv loop example (streaming):

```go
st, _ := client.ChatStream(ctx, opts)
for { chunk, err := st.Recv(); if err==io.EOF{break}; if err!=nil{log.Fatal(err)}; fmt.Print(chunk.Delta) }
```

ci-bot: snippets-lint passed for PR #4920. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all. Merging after I add the opaque-token caveat and a short note about possible duplicate items on resume. If anything breaks we can follow up with a test.
